title: Tracking area updating procedure for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services not accepted by the network

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure for emergency bearer services rejected
entities.description: Procedure executed when a tracking area updating request for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services is not accepted by the network.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure for emergency bearer services abnormal cases
entities.description: Procedure executed when tracking area updating request for emergency bearer services fails due to abnormal cases.

entities.name: UE in same selected PLMN
entities.description: Condition where the UE is in the same selected PLMN where the last tracking area updating request was attempted.

entities.name: Inform upper layers of procedure failure
entities.description: Action where the UE informs upper layers about the failure of the emergency bearer services procedure.

entities.name: Detach locally and attempt EPS attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Action where the UE detaches locally (if not already detached) and attempts EPS attach for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: CS emergency call establishment
entities.description: Procedure where upper layers establish a CS emergency call as fallback when emergency bearer services fail.

relations.description: Procedure execution is guarded by the condition that UE is in same selected PLMN.
When UE is in same selected PLMN, it establishes the action to inform upper layers of procedure failure.
When UE is in same selected PLMN, it establishes the action to detach locally and attempt EPS attach for emergency bearer services.
Informing upper layers of failure can establish CS emergency call procedure as fallback.
Abnormal case procedure establishes action to inform upper layers of network access failure.
